title: Correlated expectation of linear forms
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $-1\leq\rho\leq1$, and let $a_1,\ldots,a_n\in\bbr$. Choose $X$ uniformly from ${-1,1}^n$ and, independently at each coordinate conditional on $X$, form $Y$ by keeping $X_i$ with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and flipping its sign otherwise. Then the expectation of $(\sum_{i=1}^n a_iX_i)(\sum_{i=1}^n a_iY_i)$ is $rho\sum_{i=1}^n a_i^2$.
hypotheses_covered: Real coefficient vector $a$ indexed by the $n$ coordinates
